body: 在纯白背景中央生成樱桃emoji 🍒 的极简8-bit像素标志。限制为红、深红、绿、深绿、白的复古色板，均匀方格像素、硬边、块状结构，两颗樱桃和相连绿梗清楚可辨。无阴影、无渐变、无多余装饰、无文字。方形画布。

en.title: Cherry pixel-style icon
en.description: Two cherries and joined stems are recognizable with hard block edges on white. Some internal tonal variation remains; this is a raster concept, not a cleaned pixel sprite.
en.body:
## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

Two cherries and joined stems are recognizable with hard block edges on white. Some internal tonal variation remains; this is a raster concept, not a cleaned pixel sprite.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 57. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.

zh-Hans.body:
## 使用方法

复制本图实际使用的完整提示词。修改主体后属于尚未验证的新变体。本次未使用参考图。

## 观察结果

白底两颗樱桃与相连绿梗清楚，边缘为像素块；内部仍有明暗变化，属于栅格概念图，未作像素网格清理。

## 来源

根据所提供设计 Prompt 清单第 57 条独立改写。[来源页面](https://pixonara.com/prompts/ai-product-photo-prompts)。生成工具未返回精确模型版本。
